rows.name: size
rows.description: Use this prop to choose the size of the dropdown

rows.name: value
rows.description: The value of the DropdownSelect. This value is used for the controlled case of the DropdownSelect Component, alongside with the onValueChange callback.

rows.name: supportMessage
rows.description: The support message text. It also controls the visibility of the support message. If the mode is standard, then this property is ignored.

rows.name: supportMessageProps
rows.description: The extra props for the SupportMessage Component.

rows.name: required
rows.description: Use this prop to show the asterisk(*) sign along side label. The required behavior needs to be handled.

rows.name: icon
rows.description: The icon on the left side of the DropdownSelect text

rows.name: expanded
rows.description: default expanded state for the flyout menu

rows.name: collapseDownIcon
rows.description: The icon used for the collapsed state (down).

rows.name: collapseUpIcon
rows.description: The icon element used for the expanded state (up).

rows.name: onValueChange
rows.description: Fires when the selected value changes.
rows.type: ((selected: { id?: string; value?: string; label?: string | undefined; }) => void) | undefined

rows.name: onExpandedChange
rows.description: Fires when the dropdown state changes.
